# JM Cooling LLC

> Mini split & AC installation based in Bulverde, Texas. JM Cooling installs and cleans ductless mini splits and central AC north of San Antonio. Reviewers say Jerry takes time with every question and the crew shows up on time.

## Services
- Ductless mini split installs: Single-zone heads for bedrooms, living rooms and additions, with neat line-set covers outside.
- Multi-zone systems: Several rooms, several condensers, laid out so the outside of the house still looks tidy.
- Sheds, shops & garages: Cooling for workshops, metal buildings, barn-style sheds and other spaces without ductwork.
- Mini split cleaning & maintenance: Cleanings that keep a mini split blowing cold, for systems JM Cooling installed years ago too.
- Central AC & service calls: Central AC work and repair visits for homes and shops in the Bulverde area.

## About
JM Cooling LLC is an air conditioning company in the Bulverde and Spring Branch area of Comal County, run by owner Jerry. Most of its jobs are ductless mini splits: single heads in bedrooms and living rooms, rows of condensers along a house, and units for sheds, workshops and metal shop buildings. Jerry often comes out himself to look at the job and answer questions, and customers say booking is easy and appointment dates come quickly. Many come back: one homeowner who had mini splits installed called again a couple of years later for a cleaning and had a technician out within a day.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you put a mini split in my shed, shop or garage?
  A: Yes. JM Cooling has installed mini splits on a barn-style shed, in a plywood-walled workshop and outside a metal shop building.
- Q: Do you clean mini splits after the install?
  A: Yes. One customer called Jerry a couple of years after the install for a cleaning and had a technician there within a day.
- Q: Do you offer financing?
  A: Yes. Customers mention being offered financing when they booked. Ask about it when you request a quote.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 9 AM to 6 PM, and Sunday 11 AM to 4 PM.
- Q: Which areas do you cover?
  A: Bulverde and Spring Branch, plus New Braunfels, Canyon Lake, Boerne and San Antonio.
